obligations.proof: Any one-clause CNF is satisfiable: choose an assignment satisfying one of its literals. Thus canonical UNSAT requires m>=2. Canonical length is 8+(2 floor(log2 v)+1)+(2 floor(log2 m)+1)+3m(1+bit_length(v)), before optional padding. With v>=1,m>=2 this is at least 8+1+3+12=24, already even. Hence H_k is empty for k<12 and k=12 is first admissible.

At total length 24 every lower bound in O1 is equality. Therefore v=1 and m=2. The raw length is 24, so optional padding is absent. MAGIC||gamma(1)||gamma(2)=11100101||1||010 has length 12, placing the equal split exactly before the payload.
For v=1 each of six literals is encoded as sign||1. Thus c is 12 payload bits and h=1||c. Zero-indexed bit 4 of h is the variable-code bit of the second literal and equals 1.
Every p in P_13 is the first 13 bits of a canonical length-26 word and therefore begins with MAGIC=11100101. Its zero-indexed bit 4 equals MAGIC[4]=0.
O3 fixes bit 4 to 1 on every h in H_12, whereas O4 fixes bit 4 to 0 on every p in P_13. Exact equality is impossible, so H_12 intersection P_13 is empty.
No decoder, split, or coordinate map changes. For x=r||c the transposed query remains (2^12+c,r), exactly the C048 endpoint-swapped reduction.
